error[ZBX-E0403]: can't signal the container
  while  stopping the container web-1
  cause  signalling the container's PID 1 failed: operation not permitted
         (EPERM)
  cause  the record names pid 502; it belongs to another user, or the number was
         reused
  name   web-1
  pid    502
  fix    look at the process:   ps -o pid,user,stat,args -p <pid>
  more   zbx explain E0403
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0403.html
